input.context: Apply last week's grades from review-log.csv to flashcards.csv with SM-2, spread this week's due cards (at most 15 a day, Sunday off), save the updated deck as a CSV artifact and report cards due per day and the five weakest cards. The files are flashcards.csv (id, deck, front, back, ease, interval_days, reps, lapses, due) and review-log.csv (date, card_id, grade 0 to 5) in your workspace; the plan starts Monday 2026-11-02.

Write a 10-question quiz from the Tutor's five weakest cards and this week's due cards (at least 3 per deck, one applied question per deck), questions on one artifact and answers with mnemonics for 3+ lapses on a second. Use the Tutor's report below for the weakest cards and the due list; quote the cards' backs exactly in the answers.

Verify the Tutor's schedule with run_code (no day over 15, no Sunday, every ease at least 1.3) and that each quiz answer matches its card's back. The Tutor's numbers and the Quizmaster's answer sheet are in the reports below; report every mismatch, or say that all checks hold.
